text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you have several tasks, it is important to prioritize them, deciding which ones are urgent and which can wait. This helps you focus on what matters most. Scope management is also key: if a task is too big, break it into smaller steps or agree on what is realistic to finish. Finally, never forget communication. If you think you might miss a deadline, tell your manager or team early. Honest updates build trust and allow others to help. Good planning, clear priorities, and open communication make deadlines much easier to manage.
